sources.facts: Only two detailed member tiers: $130 monthly with two half-circle firing shelves, or $250 with four; each shelf allowance 6in tall ×26in wide ×13in deep. Two-hour open-studio trial; work retained only after joining with shelf space. One 6cuft/two 10cuft kilns. Bisque ^06–^04; glaze ^5/6; material brands/firing specifications and preapproved glazes matter.
Open membership up to three weekly visits; firing membership one weekly session. Independent experienced adults. Current eight-week offers $348/$168; availability is a dated snapshot.
Up to two makeup classes per session when an alternate class has room; only registered students/members. Refund policy varies by timing and filled replacement place.
Weekly three-hour adult classes plus additional open access; one 25lb clay bag. Current classes differ in seven/eight-week duration.
Independent artists: £150–250/month; seven-day unbooked access; nine wheels and three electric kilns with weekly firing. Members bring own materials.

Booked two/three-hour experienced-adult sessions; only studio clay/glazes, no tuition. Acuity five/ten-session packs. Reschedule up to six hours before; no refunds. Optional per-piece firing, mug example £5, up to four weeks. Work-in-progress storage maximum six months.

Seven wheels; staff-managed firing. £85/month one weekly three-hour session, £120 two; same page also says 12/24 flexible monthly hours. Additional three hours £25. Two-month minimum, one-month notice, book ahead; members purchase materials.

£55, 2.5-hour taster, maximum six; one selected pot fired/glazed, normally about four weeks depending on firing schedule. Private group £300 up to six. Advance participant transfer; participant cancellation not refundable.

£102/month four three-hour sessions, current waitlist; twelve studio places, nine wheels, fifteen weekly sessions. Bookeo. Two firing stages, card payment after weighing; pickup usually two–six weeks after final firing. Body £5/kg plus £2/item disagrees with FAQ £5/kg. Own clay only by prior arrangement.
Separate six-place throwing and eight-place handbuilding rooms. Six/twelve-week courses; work collection four–six weeks afterward.
Changing pickup timetable; current Tuesday 17–19:30, Wednesday 15–17, Thursday 16–18:30, Saturday 14:30–16:30; card, no cash. Old August exceptions are not current closure inputs.
